text: Unlike Shrike-4, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Plover-6 is 1400 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Plover-6 applies to Shrike-4, the rate limit differs.
Merlin-2 was granted a budget of $3740k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Avery Okonkwo is on the pager rotation of Tern-4 this month, with a deputy as backup.

Unlike Merlin-2, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Shrike-4 is $1650k. Nobody should assume the budget of Shrike-4 applies to Merlin-2, the budget differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
The owner of Tern-4 is the Ledger team, and every change to Tern-4 goes through their review.
All instances of Egret-5 live in the datacenter at Cairo. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Plan around the retirement date of Merlin-2: July 8, 2028 is when it goes dark.

All instances of Dunlin-6 live in the datacenter at Osaka.

Questions about Shrike-4 start with its owner, the Keystone team; they triage anything filed against it.
